verdict.rationale: Rainforest exposes a documented REST API (with an OpenAPI spec) and webhooks that could let an agent programmatically read merchant deposit/status data (rainforest-docs-7, rainforest-docs-22, rainforest-docs-26), and it advertises a chargebacks component (rainforest-docs-15), which is adjacent to dispute handling. However there is no documented balance/payout-read endpoint, no guidance for investigating a missing payout, and no mention of drafting or submitting dispute evidence via API — missing for 10: balance/payout query endpoints, payout-investigation workflow docs, and dispute-evidence drafting/submission API or agent-usable surface.
